_comment: PR-8 — composes into land_type='agricultural'. SV-specific cues: cafetalera, ganadera, milpa, potrero, manzanas (Salvadoran traditional area unit). Highest signal: 'finca' alone is very strong. Word boundaries (\b) on bare single-word patterns are LOAD-BEARING — without them, English 'ranch' substring-matches Spanish 'rancho' (Salvadoran beach-pavilion, NOT a working ranch) and 'finca' substring-matches development names like 'Finca Brava'. Verified 2026-05-24: ~40 beachfront houses were mass-purged by these false positives across 3 consecutive nightlies (#443 + #444). Keep the \b convention when adding patterns.
_deprecation_notice: PR D2 (2026-06-04): the canonical source for is_agricultural patterns is now pulpo/countries/<cc>.json under the `agricultural_keywords` key. The active country's manifest takes precedence over this file at load time (see pulpo/nlp_extractor.py::load_dictionaries). This file remains as a fallback for countries that haven't been migrated yet; remove once every active country manifest carries the section.
